discrepancy_explanation: During Phase 5C.3.7 evaluation execution, the evaluation service initially serialized evaluation_report.json while guard.state was EVALUATION_IN_PROGRESS, producing SHA-256 digest 7860335bbc825c6886de34cc74448881bcc95993a4ec64d52aa6171473e3b932. This digest was recorded into guard.json upon guard finalization. The service then rebuilt and rewrote evaluation_report.json to embed the finalized guard record inside the report JSON payload. Because embedding the finalized guard altered the file bytes, the resulting final evaluation_report.json digest on disk became 1dccb491faeb871f10f84f1d5f6f2c04557172be01df1f7e7160f2489aad6fcb. The test metrics, confusion matrices, and model records were not modified. This detached manifest provides authoritative post-finalization verification linking both artifacts.
